title: Tape copying: McCartney by Paul McCartney | 1970
content:
Studio One, Morgan Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Robin Black

Paul McCartney began a five-day stretch of recording sessions for the McCartney album at Morgan Studios in London on 16 February 1970.

He began by copying his four-track home recordings to create a new eight-track master. The songs from the December 1969 Cavendish Road sessions were ‘The Lovely Linda’, ‘That Would Be Something’, ‘Momma Miss America’, ‘Rupert’, ‘Oo You’, ‘Valentine Day’, ‘Glasses’, ‘Suicide’, ‘Teddy Boy’, ‘Backwards Guitar Piece’, ‘Hot As Sun’, ‘Junk’, and ‘Singalong Junk’.
